refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review feedback highlights two partially covered CQs (CQ5, CQ13) and several quality improvements. High priority is formalizing file validity constraints (CQ13) via OWL cardinality restrictions (e.g., every Invoice must have invoiceNumber, invoiceAmount, at least one InvoiceItem, and at least one InvoiceParticipation). CQ5 needs extensibility for Organization information (e.g., taxID, contact info). Medium priorities: enrich Organization/Item with extensible properties, subclass OrganizationRole (Buyer, Seller) and Item (Product, Service), add GCAs for participation patterns. Low: disjoint unions for new subclasses.
high_priority: Add OWL cardinality restrictions to Invoice: must have exactly one invoiceNumber, exactly one invoiceAmount, at least one includesItem (InvoiceItem), at least one involvesParticipation (InvoiceParticipation).
Add restrictions for Organization: must have orgName, optionally add extensible properties (taxID, contact info).
medium_priority: Define subclasses for OrganizationRole (Buyer, Seller) and Item (Product, Service).
Add extensible properties: Organization (taxID, email, phone); Item (itemCode, unitPrice).
Add GCAs for participation patterns (e.g., every Invoice with BuyerParticipation must have an Organization with role Buyer).
low_priority: Declare disjointUnionOf for OrganizationRole and Item subclasses if time permits.
plan: 1. Add cardinality restrictions to Invoice and Organization.
